direct_phi_zero.proof: On the frame open, M a_i is projectively equal to P_i (after tau-normalization of weights). Phase 3 gives F(P_i)=0. By definition Phi(a)=F(sum a_r frame_r / tau^{deg}), so Phi(a_i)=0 as an identity of L_i-valued functions on the open.

coset_basis_interface.note: G4 supplies executable coset permutation of order-image 660

primitive_element.construction: Any H_i-invariant rational function on P(W) with full orbit size 11 under G; standard choice is a ratio of Reynolds averages of a linear form to a high even power (cf. A5Q FIELD_L*). Characteristic polynomial is the degree-11 resolvent with coefficients in K_proj.
primitive_element.name: theta_1
primitive_element.trace: sum of Galois conjugates = -coeff of T^{10}

g3_frame_point.invariance: a_i is H_i-invariant rational map, hence L_i-valued
g3_frame_point.open: det M(w) != 0 and P_i(w) != 0 and tau != 0

power_basis_reduction.explicit_coefficient_table: formula-level; modular interpolation certificates in modular_frame_samples.json
power_basis_reduction.method: Vandermonde on the eleven Galois conjugates a_i(g_j · w) for coset representatives g_j; solve for coefficients in K_proj of each coordinate in the power basis 1,theta,...,theta^{10}
